author: cli
text: Re-read 2026-08-17. The opt-in claim is verified, not assumed: cmd_setup's body contains no call to hooks install - it writes .mcp.json and the rule files and stops - so 'setup advertises this and never runs it' is still literally true, and the sentence about not writing into .git/hooks uninvited still describes the design. The unknown-action guard and the derived describe() banner below it are unchanged.
